rows.en: Would you kindly give priority to intercepting the poachers and protecting the whales?
Priority: intercept the poachers and protect the whales.
We shall now begin the patrol unit's training.
We're now starting the patrol unit's training.
The next team has appeared.
The next team has appeared.
That is the last team, I believe.
That's the last team.
Liza has come to back us up, it seems.
Liza has come to back us up!
Would you kindly cover Liza's withdrawal?
Cover Liza's withdrawal.
Liza's withdrawal confirmed.
Liza's withdrawal confirmed.
Liza's craft appears to have been disabled.
Liza's craft has been disabled.
A missile appears to have been launched from the poachers' mothership. A reaction weapon, I suspect.
rows.notes: 'hannou-dan' written with 'group'; read as reaction weapon.

rows.en: A missile was launched from the poachers' mothership. Probably a reaction weapon!
Missile believed to be a reaction weapon confirmed.
Probable reaction weapon missile confirmed.
Would you kindly destroy the reaction weapon?
Destroy the reaction weapon!
Protect the Galaxy Whales from the poachers.
Protect the Galaxy Whales from the poachers!
The Presidential Office requests S.M.S. deployment. All squadrons, scramble. Mission code Victor 3. I repeat, Victor 3 has been issued.
Presidential Office is requesting S.M.S. to deploy. All squadrons, scramble. Mission code Victor 3. I repeat, Victor 3 has been issued.
Purple and Vermillion Flights wiped out. The final defense line has been breached, it seems.
Purple and Vermillion Flights wiped out. The final defense line's been breached.
We shall hold a joint exercise with the New U.N. Forces.
We will hold a joint exercise with the New U.N. Forces.
A Konig Monster has appeared.
A Konig Monster has appeared!
Things are in confusion. The Presidential Office has given no launch clearance.
It seems to be chaos there. No launch clearance from the Presidential Office.
rows.notes: 'shiteiru yo ne' read as 'shiteiru you ne' (it seems), as Claire and Misa say.

rows.en: We shall hold a mock battle with Pixie Team.
We'll hold a mock battle with Pixie Team.
Defold reaction. It is Victor, I see.
Defold reaction. It's Victor.
Go and scout the thieves' hideout.
Go and scout the thieves' hideout.
We shall hold a mock battle with Skull Squadron.
We'll hold a mock battle with Skull Squadron.
Have you been shot down?
You were shot down?
Go and rescue our allies.
Go rescue our allies!
We have rescued our allies.
We rescued our allies!
Escape from the enemy ship.
rows.notes: Exsedol's clip is an order (seyo), like Misa's; Yuu, Claire, Pinon and Itsuki say 'we're escaping'. Translated the order.

rows.en: Please escape from the enemy ship.
rows.notes: Catherine's clip is a polite order (shite kudasai); translated as such, unlike the 'we're escaping' of most shared clips.

rows.en: Macross Cannon, charging energy.
Macross Cannon, charging energy.
Our allies are in combat. Go and support them.
Our allies are in combat! Go support them!
Would you kindly put down the Zentradi riot that broke out on Gallia 4?
Please put down the Zentradi riot that broke out on Gallia 4.
Would you kindly investigate the inside of the old Macross the Vajra are believed to have sunk?
Please investigate the inside of the old Macross the Vajra are believed to have sunk.
It is going to explode! Escape!
It's going to blow! Get out!
An unidentified fold fault is heading this way. Evacuate at once.
rows.notes: 'fooldo danso' read as fold dansou (fold fault).

rows.en: An unidentified fold fault is heading our way. Evacuate at once.
Numerous defold reactions confirmed in the space ahead. They keep increasing. Several carrier-class ships too. A veritable horde.
rows.notes: 'chuuiki' read as 'chuuiki' (space zone); trailing 'desu ga' read as 'desu na'.

rows.en: Many defold reactions confirmed in the space ahead. They keep increasing. Several carrier-class ships too. It's a huge fleet.
Captain!
rows.notes: 'kanshou' read as 'kanchou' (captain), as the other operators say.

rows.en: Captain!
We shall conduct an experiment using Ranka Lee's song.
We'll run an experiment using Ranka Lee's song.
Ranka Attack, commencing.
Ranka Attack, begin!
Would you kindly escort the Macross Quarter?
Please escort the Macross Quarter.
Our gunfire is not getting through to the Vajra, I see.
Gunfire isn't working on the Vajra!
Gunfire is not working. Take them down in melee.
Gunfire isn't working. Take them down in melee.
Escort Battle Frontier until the ultra-long-range fold begins.
Please escort Battle Frontier until the ultra-long-range fold starts.
Ultra-long-range fold commencing.
Ultra-long-range fold starting.

uncertain: rows 849-850: both new clips are orders ('escape from the enemy ship'), while most shared operator clips say 'we're escaping'; translated what these clips say.
